SOUNDS_DECK.Title: Sounds Deck
SOUNDS_DECK.NoBeds: No bed yet. A playlist whose name starts with a number and a dot (1 · …) appears here.
SOUNDS_DECK.Layout: Board beside or below the beds
SOUNDS_DECK.NoBanks: No bank yet. A playlist whose name starts with an emoji appears here: Soundboard Only for one-shots, Simultaneous for room loops, Sequential for events.
SOUNDS_DECK.NoPress: Shuffle mode gives these pads nothing to do: choose Soundboard Only, Simultaneous or Sequential.
SOUNDS_DECK.DucksOn: The music drops under this event - click to keep it at full
SOUNDS_DECK.DucksOff: The music stays at full under this event - click to lower it
SOUNDS_DECK.Filter: Filter the pads - glass, heartbeat, ponctuels…

Help.Title: How the deck reads your playlists
Help.Intro: Sounds Deck plays Foundry's own playlists. Two things decide everything: the playlist's name and its mode.
Help.Bed: A name that starts with a number and a dot (5 · Wrong) is music: a card, one playing at a time.
Help.Bank: A name that starts with an emoji (💥 Ponctuels) is a bank of pads. Its mode decides what a pad does:
Help.OneShot: Soundboard Only: a one-shot, heard by everyone, and it can overlap itself.
Help.Toggle: Simultaneous: a loop you switch on and off; the others keep playing.
Help.Cue: Sequential: an event, with pause, stop and position below the board; the music drops under it (the small speaker beside the pad turns that off).
Help.Shuffle: Shuffle: nothing - the bank is shown greyed.
Help.Neither: A name with neither stays off the deck.
Help.Scenes: A scene that carries a playlist starts its music when it opens. Music you pick by hand keeps playing into a scene that has none.
Help.Source: Hover a pad to see where its sound comes from: the sound's own description in the playlist sidebar.

Journal.Name: Sounds Deck: keep a press log on this seat
Journal.Hint: Off by default. Records each press on the deck (music, pads, events) with the time, in this browser only, so a session can be reviewed afterwards. Export it from the deck's menu.

SOUNDS_DECK.RandomOn: Firing at random moments - click to stop
SOUNDS_DECK.RandomOff: Fire this at random moments (every 10–45 s)
